protocolDosing.notes: 25 mg/day robustly elevates testosterone in trial data; used for PCT after AAS/SARM cycles; not FDA-approved (NDA failed 2013); compounding-pharmacy Rx

mechanismOfAction.summary: SERM; ER antagonist at hypothalamus/pituitary → disinhibition of LH/FSH secretion → increased endogenous testosterone.
mechanismOfAction.description: Trans-isomer (E-isomer) of clomiphene; blocks estrogen receptor at hypothalamus and pituitary, removing negative feedback and raising endogenous LH/FSH/testosterone. Differs from cis-isomer (zuclomiphene) which is a weak ER agonist. CYP2D6 metabolism; Tmax ~2–3 h; t½ ~10 h.
